source_batch.unit_label: BRBL::MOD_D::U10: Recognise partnership through agreement,business,profit and mutual agency

payload.title: Mutual agency distinguishes the relationship
payload.core_explanation_md:
Partnership depends on a contractual relationship for carrying on a business with the relevant profit-sharing and mutual-agency features. The agreement may be evidenced orally,by writing or by conduct; a document headed partnership is not the only possible evidence. Family status or receiving income alone does not create the relationship.

A lender,employee or former owner may receive an amount linked to profits without becoming a partner. Ask whether the business is conducted by all,or by someone acting for all. Do not infer a partner status merely from the payment formula. An ordinary firm also differs from an incorporated body: the legal consequences of partner agency and liability require separate examination.

self_check.prompt_text: Does a profit-linked payment establish partnership by itself?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. Assess the real contractual relationship and mutual agency.

payload.stem_md: A business pays its lender an agreed return linked to annual profit. No mutual agency or partnership agreement is established. Which conclusion is supported?

options.text_md: The lender necessarily becomes a partner
The payment arrangement alone does not prove partnership
options.explanation_md: The underlying relationship and agency must be examined.

options.text_md: No partnership can exist without registration
options.explanation_md: Formation and registration have distinct consequences.

options.text_md: Every creditor is an agent for the business owners
options.explanation_md: Creditorship does not establish mutual agency.

payload.correct_explanation_md: The underlying relationship and agency must be examined.

payload.stem_md: Two people agree to run a repair business through either acting for both and share its profits. Which feature distinguishes this from passive co-ownership?

options.explanation_md: Residence does not establish the relationship.

options.text_md: The age of the workshop building
options.explanation_md: That is not the legal distinction.

options.text_md: Their use of the same bank branch
The agreed business and mutual-agency relationship
options.explanation_md: The business is carried on for both through the agreed agency.

payload.correct_explanation_md: The business is carried on for both through the agreed agency.
